أصطخم (form VIII)
# أَصْطَخِمُ (ʔaṣṭaḵimu) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.xi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# أَصْطَخِمَ (ʔaṣṭaḵima) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.xi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# أَصْطَخِمْ (ʔaṣṭaḵim) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.xim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
